description: Query the Internet Archive's Wayback index for any URL: when it was first archived, the most recent snapshot, how many years it spans, and recent capture dates. Useful for fact-checking page history, finding deleted content and due-diligence. Use this when an agent needs to how the Internet Archive remembers a URL. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_archive_lookup
title: Archive Lookup (Wayback)
